dialogue.content: 「本日よろしくお願いいたします。」
dialogue.English: It's a pleasure to speak with you today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to it as well.

dialogue.content: 何かリクエスト希望あれば気軽に相談してくださいね宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Please feel free to let me know if you have any requests or preferences. I'm here to help.

dialogue.content: 「時間になりましたら始めますね宜しくお願い致します。」
dialogue.English: We'll begin at the scheduled time. Thank you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to it.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Likewise, I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: 本日は相談に来てくれてありがとうございます。はじめに年齢、性別、宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: １６歳　男です
dialogue.English: I'm 16 years old and male.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日の相談内容と呼んでも大丈夫なお名前も宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Please also tell me what you’d like to talk about today and the name you’re comfortable being called.

dialogue.content: 山田です。学校ですぐ感情的になる人がいて悩んでます。
dialogue.English: My name is Yamada. I'm having trouble with someone at school who gets emotional very easily.

dialogue.content: 山田さん相談ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that, Yamada.

dialogue.content: 学校で感情的になる人がいてその人のことで相談に来られたんですね
dialogue.English: So you've come to talk about someone at your school who gets emotional.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その方についてもう少し詳しく聴いても大丈夫ですか
dialogue.English: Would it be all right if I asked you to tell me a little more about this person?

dialogue.content: はい！急に怒りだしたり、話もしていないのに話しに割り込んできたりします
dialogue.English: Yes! They suddenly get angry, and they'll interrupt conversations even when they're not part of them.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 急に話に割り込んできてしまう人がいるんですね
dialogue.English: So there's someone who suddenly interrupts your conversations.

dialogue.content: はい、周りの人も変なやつだと言っていて
dialogue.English: Yes, and other people around us also say they're strange.

dialogue.content: 急に怒り出されるとビックリしませんでしたか
dialogue.English: It must be surprising when they suddenly get angry, isn't it?

dialogue.content: ビックリします
dialogue.English: It's very startling.

dialogue.content: そうですよね急にだとよりビックリしたりすると思うので
dialogue.English: I can imagine. It must be even more startling because it's so sudden.

dialogue.content: その人は同じクラスの人ですか
dialogue.English: Is this person in your class?

dialogue.content: 同じクラスです
dialogue.English: Yes, they're in my class.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 今まで話したりすることはありましたか
dialogue.English: Have you spoken with them before?

dialogue.content: クラスメイトなので、話しかけられたらするくらいです。仲が凄いいいわけでもないです、、、
dialogue.English: We're classmates, so I'll talk to them if they talk to me. But we're not particularly close...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 急に怒ったり、大きな声を
dialogue.English: When they suddenly get angry or raise their voice—

dialogue.content: 出されると
dialogue.English: when that happens,

dialogue.content: その人は普段からよく人の話に入ってくる人ですか
dialogue.English: Do they often jump into other people’s conversations in general?

dialogue.content: ビクビクしちゃうんです
dialogue.English: it makes me feel on edge.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 他の人と話してる時に
dialogue.English: When I’m talking with other people,

dialogue.content: ビクビクしちゃいますよね
dialogue.English: It's understandable that you'd feel on edge.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 自分の話をしてきます
dialogue.English: they come over and start talking about themselves.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 誰の話でも入ってきちゃうんですか
dialogue.English: So they'll jump into anyone's conversation?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: みてると
dialogue.English: From what I’ve seen,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その時感心を持った人に
dialogue.English: whoever catches their interest at that moment—

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 行ってる感じがします
dialogue.English: it seems like they go over to them.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その人はクラスに友達や仲良くしてる人はいますか
dialogue.English: Do they have friends or people they’re close with in the class?

dialogue.content: よく、1人でいるのをみますが、、、多分。自分から無理やり、話しにいくので
dialogue.English: I often see them alone... I think. They tend to force themselves into conversations.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 誰かしらとはいるのは、みます
dialogue.English: I do see them with someone or other.

dialogue.content: そうな
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。失礼いたしました。
dialogue.English: I see. My apologies.

dialogue.content: でも
dialogue.English: But—

dialogue.content: 誰かしらとはいるんですね
dialogue.English: So they are with someone at times.

dialogue.content: やっぱり他の人も
dialogue.English: After all, other people also—

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 嫌そうです
dialogue.English: seem annoyed.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: その人嫌われてるの自分で気づいてはいない感じですか
dialogue.English: Does it seem like they don’t realize they’re disliked?

dialogue.content: どうなんでしょうか？一度、急に大声をだしたので
dialogue.English: I’m not sure. Once, they suddenly shouted, so...

dialogue.content: 大声ですか
dialogue.English: They shouted?

dialogue.content: そんな事したら嫌われるよって、
dialogue.English: I told them, “If you do that, people will dislike you,”

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 勇気を出して
dialogue.English: I worked up the courage

dialogue.content: 言ったんですが
dialogue.English: and said it, but—

dialogue.content: 言ってあげたんですか
dialogue.English: You said that to them?

dialogue.content: は？
dialogue.English: 'Huh?'

dialogue.content: みたいな感じで
dialogue.English: —that was their reaction.

dialogue.content: 反応がちょっと怖いですよね
dialogue.English: That kind of reaction can feel a bit scary, can’t it?

dialogue.content: わかってなさそうでした
dialogue.English: It didn't seem like they understood.

dialogue.content: 周りのお友達大丈夫でしたか
dialogue.English: Were your friends around you okay?

dialogue.content: 他の人が、先生にも言ったみたいなんですが
dialogue.English: It seems others also told the teacher, but—

dialogue.content: わかってないのが一番迷惑ですよね
dialogue.English: Not understanding is the most troublesome part, isn't it?

dialogue.content: その子は、変わらないです
dialogue.English: That person hasn’t changed.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 注意されても変わらないのは困りますよね
dialogue.English: It's difficult when someone doesn't change even after being told, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、困るし、ちょっと
dialogue.English: Yes, it’s a problem, and it’s a bit—

dialogue.content: 怖いです
dialogue.English: scary.

dialogue.content: ちょっと、いやだいぶ変わっていますし怖いですよね
dialogue.English: A little... no, it's quite unusual and scary, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: 頻繫にあるなら余計にそうだと思うので
dialogue.English: I imagine it's even more so if it happens frequently.

dialogue.content: クラスでそのことについて話し合いとかは難しそうですか
dialogue.English: Does it seem difficult to have a class discussion about it?

dialogue.content: そうですね。先生に言ってもなにもしてくれないですし。無視してる人達も多い
dialogue.English: I think so. The teacher doesn't do anything even when we tell them. And many people are just ignoring them,

dialogue.content: ので
dialogue.English: so—

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 難しいと思います。。。
dialogue.English: I think it would be difficult...

dialogue.content: それは、とても困りましたね
dialogue.English: That’s a very difficult situation.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 他にクラスで困ったことはありますか
dialogue.English: Is there anything else that's troubling you in class?

dialogue.content: 他には特にないです
dialogue.English: No, not really.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: その子の親御さんはどんなかたかは知りませんか
dialogue.English: Do you happen to know what their parents are like?

dialogue.content: わかりません。。。
dialogue.English: I don’t know...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 急に怒って来るのは、どんな話の時がおおいでしょうか
dialogue.English: When they suddenly get angry, what kind of conversations are usually happening?

dialogue.content: うるさいとか、なんか気にいらない事があったのか
dialogue.English: Maybe because it's noisy, or something displeased them,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 思うようにならないからなのか
dialogue.English: or because things aren't going their way.

dialogue.content: そんな時が多いんですね
dialogue.English: So it happens often in those situations.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いわゆる自己中心的な人なんでしょうか
dialogue.English: So would you say they are what you'd call a self-centered person?

dialogue.content: そうですね。なんか、空気よめないやつ
dialogue.English: Yes. Like, someone who can't read the room,

dialogue.content: みたいな
dialogue.English: sort of like that.

dialogue.content: 感じです
dialogue.English: That's the feeling.

dialogue.content: 大変ですねそれは、周りが
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult for everyone around them.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: It is.

dialogue.content: クラスでどうしようもないみたいですし
dialogue.English: And it seems like there's nothing that can be done in the class,

dialogue.content: 余計に大声出されても困りますし
dialogue.English: and it would be troublesome if they started shouting even more.

dialogue.content: 他にこうしたらとかいう提案も周りからはない感じでしょうか
dialogue.English: Are there no suggestions from others on what to do?

dialogue.content: そうですね。周りは、無視しよーみたいな空気ですね
dialogue.English: Right. The general mood around is ‘let’s just ignore them.’

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 山田さんも同じ様に無視している感じですか
dialogue.English: Are you also trying to ignore them in the same way, Yamada?

dialogue.content: 無視までは、してないですけど、、、
dialogue.English: I’m not ignoring them completely, but...

dialogue.content: 距離を置きたいと思ってます
dialogue.English: I do want to keep my distance.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: Yes!

dialogue.content: 少し悲しくもなりますがしょうがないですよね
dialogue.English: It's a little sad, but it can't be helped, can it?

dialogue.content: あと少しでクラス替えもあるので、、、そこまでは、
dialogue.English: There's a class change coming up soon, so until then...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: Oh, I see.

dialogue.content: 今は、大変ですがクラス替えで違うクラスならモチベーションもあがりそうですよね
dialogue.English: It's tough right now, but if you're in a different class after the change, that might lift your spirits, right?

dialogue.content: 我慢なのか、、なーと。
dialogue.English: I guess I just have to endure it...

dialogue.content: 辛いですね。我慢は
dialogue.English: Enduring it is hard, isn't it?

dialogue.content: かわらないので。
dialogue.English: Because they won't change.

dialogue.content: 周りには愚痴言い合えてたりしますか
dialogue.English: Are you able to vent about it with friends around you?

dialogue.content: なんだあいつみたいな
dialogue.English: Like, ‘What’s with that person?’

dialogue.content: 話しは、します
dialogue.English: We do talk about it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, we do.

dialogue.content: 話せてるなら少しは気持ちが楽になれますか
dialogue.English: Does being able to talk about it make you feel a little better?

dialogue.content: 山田さんもお友達も
dialogue.English: Both you and your friends?

dialogue.content: はい、その時は、いいんですが
dialogue.English: Yes, it helps at the time, but—

dialogue.content: また
dialogue.English: when it happens again,

dialogue.content: 同じ事されると
dialogue.English: when they do the same thing,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 嫌になります
dialogue.English: I get fed up.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: That makes sense.

dialogue.content: 今日話したいこと話せていますか
dialogue.English: Have you been able to say everything you wanted to talk about today?

dialogue.content: はい。多分
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so.

dialogue.content: 話してくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing with me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: You're welcome.

dialogue.content: 困ったクラスの人ですもんね治りそうもないですし
dialogue.English: It's a difficult classmate, isn't it? And it doesn't seem like they're going to change.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: クラス替えはもう少しなんですかね
dialogue.English: Is the class change coming up soon?

dialogue.content: 4月から新しくなります
dialogue.English: It changes in April.

dialogue.content: それならいいですね。
dialogue.English: Oh, that's good then.

dialogue.content: は、はい
dialogue.English: Y-yes.

dialogue.content: もう少し絶えないといけないのは大変ですが
dialogue.English: It's hard that you have to endure it a little longer, but

dialogue.content: 周りの友達と乗り越えられるといいですね。
dialogue.English: I hope you can get through it with the support of your friends.

dialogue.content: そう思う様にしてみます
dialogue.English: I’ll try to think that way.

dialogue.content: 辛いと思いますが
dialogue.English: I know it’s difficult, but...

dialogue.content: 後はそうゆう人だと割り切って付き合うと少し楽になれるかもしれません
dialogue.English: Also, it might become a little easier if you can just accept that that's the kind of person they are and interact with them on that basis.

dialogue.content: わかりました。
dialogue.English: Okay, I understand.

dialogue.content: 今日は相談してみてどうでしたか
dialogue.English: How do you feel after talking about it today?

dialogue.content: お話しできてよかったです
dialogue.English: I'm glad I was able to talk about it.

dialogue.content: 私もお話しきけてよかったですありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I'm also glad I could listen. Thank you.

dialogue.content: また、何かあれば気軽に相談してくださいね
dialogue.English: If anything else comes up, please feel free to talk to me again.

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 本日は相談ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your consultation today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: では失礼致しますね
dialogue.English: Well then, take care.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.
